description: Order book snapshots and updates - guarantees delivery of all updates for maintaining accurate order book
important: Use level2 to guarantee order book sync and no missed updates

unsubscribe_request.product_ids: optional - specific products to unsubscribe from

notes: Level2 guarantees delivery of all order book updates. First message contains full snapshot, subsequent messages are updates to apply. Use to maintain accurate order book state.
use_case: Maintain accurate order book snapshots, track liquidity at price levels, detect support/resistance
message_flow: Initial snapshot message (type='snapshot'), followed by update messages (type='update')
